using-dualcraft: DualCraft workflow - project context from the brain, work mode before working, capture out-of-scope work, route to the right dualcraft skill. Use at the start of any conversation in a project with a .dualcraft/ folder or when DualCraft is mentioned.
help: Lists DualCraft commands by pack, installed or not. Use for /dualcraft:help, "¿qué comandos hay?", "qué puedo hacer con dualcraft".
new-project: New project from zero - full intake form (idea, type, platforms, stacks, backend, design, MVP features), then brief, decisions, MVP tasks, functional doc and scaffolding. Use for "nuevo proyecto", "empezamos de cero", or start in an empty folder.
stacks: Supported stacks (Next.js, React+Vite, Astro, Nuxt, Flutter, React Native, KMP, Android, iOS) and adding one to the project. Use for "¿qué tecnologías soporta?", "añade una app/web al proyecto", or before working in a non-default stack.
start: Starts work - sets up .dualcraft the first time, loads context and asks the work mode (bug or short task, new development, refactor) before any code. Use for "empezamos", "quiero hacer X", or when the context says the work mode is not chosen.
commit: Conventional Commits from the work mode, linked to brain ids, with CHANGELOG; asks before committing, never pushes unasked. Use for "haz commit", "commitea", "sube los cambios", or when verified work is done.
brain: Project brain - capture and query tasks, bugs, notes and ideas with dependencies and target versions. Use for "apunta", "déjalo para luego", "¿qué tenemos pendiente?", "backlog", or when out-of-scope work comes up.
decisions: Project decisions (ADR) - record, list by area, find related, check conflicts, supersede with history. Use for "hemos decidido", "a partir de ahora", "¿qué decidimos sobre…?", "cambiamos de idea", or when a request contradicts a decision.
park: Parks finished work that must wait for a later version (parked branch or feature flag) and resumes it later. Use for "déjalo para la siguiente versión", "apárcalo", "no lo metas en esta versión", "¿qué hay aparcado?".
map: Visual map of the brain - notes as nodes, dependencies as arrows, filters and detail panel (also roadmap view). Use for "enséñame el mapa", "qué depende de qué", "ver el brain".
roadmap: Roadmap by target version with progress, blocked and parked items, as a board or a chat summary. Use for "roadmap", "¿qué entra en la próxima versión?", "qué falta para la 1.3".
brainstorm: Explores an idea before building it (goal, flows per platform, data, edge cases, options) into an agreed design; leftovers go to the brain. Use in new-development mode before code, or for "tengo una idea", "quiero añadir…", "¿cómo hacemos…?".
plan: Written implementation plan (small steps, exact files, tests first, checks) saved and executed step by step. Use for multi-step or cross-platform work, after a brainstorm, or "sigue con el plan".
tdd: Test first, watch it fail, minimum code to pass, refactor green; same cases on every platform. Use before writing implementation code, or for "con tests", "hazlo con TDD".
debug: Root cause before any fix - reproduce, gather evidence, test hypotheses, fix the cause, check the other platform. Use for any bug, crash or failing test, "no funciona", "falla", or when a previous fix didn't work.
verify: Evidence before saying done - run analyzer, types, lint, tests, build and decision checks for each affected platform and report. Use before claiming work is finished, committing or closing a task, or for "¿funciona?", "comprueba que va bien".
review: Code review - correctness, lifecycle, cross-platform consistency, decisions, design tokens, security, accessibility - ranked findings with file:line. Use for "revisa el código", "¿está bien esto?", or before merging.
docs: Functional document (docs/FUNCTIONAL.md) kept current per feature and platform, traceable to brain ids. Use for "documento funcional", "documenta esto", "¿qué hace la app?", or after a verified feature.
web-architecture: Maps the web app structure (Next.js, React+Vite, Astro, Nuxt) into .dualcraft/architecture/web.md and says where each change goes. Use for "¿dónde va esto en la web?", "cómo está organizada la web", or before a new page or feature.
web-build: Builds the web app and fixes build problems - dependencies, upgrades, types, lint, env vars, deploy builds. Use for "no compila la web", "falla el build", "actualiza Next/React", "instala X en la web".
web-test: Web tests - unit, components, route handlers, e2e - right level, proper mocks, setup if missing. Use for "tests de la web", "añade tests a este componente", "e2e", or when TDD needs a web test.
web-browser: Runs the web app and checks it in a browser - screenshots at desktop and mobile widths, console errors, flows, comparison with designs. Use for "ábrela en el navegador", "mira cómo se ve la web", "haz captura".
web-seo: SEO and performance - metadata, sitemap, canonical, hreflang, structured data, Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse. Use for "SEO", "posicionamiento", "Google no indexa", "la web va lenta", or before public pages.
mobile-architecture: Maps the mobile app structure (Flutter, React Native, KMP, Android, iOS) into .dualcraft/architecture/mobile.md and says where each change goes. Use for "¿dónde va esto en la app?", "cómo está organizada la app", or before a new screen.
mobile-build: Builds the mobile app and fixes build problems - dependencies, Gradle, pods, flavors, codegen, signing, store builds and versioning. Use for "no compila la app", "falla Gradle", "error de pods", "genera el appbundle/ipa".
mobile-test: Mobile tests - unit, widget/component, golden, integration - with fakes for Firebase and plugins. Use for "tests de la app", "test de este widget", "integration test", or when TDD needs a mobile test.
mobile-device: Emulators and devices - start, install, run, screenshots, logs, deep links, adb UI automation, permissions. Use for "arranca el emulador", "instala la app", "captura del móvil", "mira los logs".
mobile-crash: Crash analysis from stack traces, logcat, iOS logs, Crashlytics or Sentry to the root cause in code. Use when a trace or crash report is shared, or for "la app se cierra", "crash", "ANR", "pantalla roja".
refactor-web: Safe web refactoring without behaviour change - components, server/client split, data fetching, duplication, dead code, adoption of shared sources - small green steps. Use for "refactoriza la web", "limpia este componente".
refactor-mobile: Safe mobile refactoring without behaviour change - widget/screen decomposition, state, repositories, lifecycle, duplication, shared sources - small green steps. Use for "refactoriza la app", "este widget es enorme".
refactor-global: Cross-platform refactoring - finds business rules duplicated or drifting between web and mobile and moves them to one place or shared test cases. Use for "unifica web y app", "esto está duplicado en las dos", "no hacen lo mismo".
i18n: Texts from one source (.dualcraft/i18n, ICU) generated for every stack; finds missing keys and hard-coded strings, adds languages. Use for "traduce", "añade inglés", "textos sin traducir", "cambia este texto".
analytics: Tracking plan (.dualcraft/analytics/events.json) validated and generated as typed helpers for every stack, with ANALYTICS.md and per-platform coverage. Use for "analítica", "eventos", "quiero medir…", "¿estamos midiendo X?".
schema: Database schema (.dualcraft/db/schema.dbml) as the single source of truth, generating models for every stack and Firestore rules. Use when defining or changing stored data, "saca el modelo de datos del código", or before hand-writing models.
er: ER diagram of the schema - tables, crow's-foot relations, drag, PNG/SVG export. Use for "enséñame el modelo de datos", "diagrama de la base de datos", "esquema ER".
database: Creates the database and environments (Firebase, Supabase, Postgres+Prisma; local, dev, prod) with each CLI, migrations with RLS, rules and safe promotion to prod. Use for "crea la base de datos", "configura Firebase/Supabase", "aplica la migración".
backend: Serverless backend from one contract (.dualcraft/backend/api.json) - Firebase Cloud Functions, Supabase Edge Functions or Next.js/Nuxt API routes; scaffolds callables, webhooks, triggers and cron jobs, server validators and typed clients for every stack. Use for "crea una función", "endpoint", "Cloud Function", "webhook", "cron", "backend".
payments: In-app purchases on Google Play and the App Store - one product catalog (.dualcraft/payments/products.json) for subscriptions, one-time unlocks and consumables; native mode with server verification and store notifications, or RevenueCat; typed catalogs and a Flutter purchase service. Use for "compras in-app", "suscripción", "premium", "monedas", "RevenueCat".
push: Push notifications with FCM for Android, iOS and web - one catalog (.dualcraft/push/notifications.json) of channels, topics and typed notifications with deep links, texts from the shared i18n in each device's language, device registration, typed senders and parsers per stack, Flutter PushService. Use for "notificaciones push", "avisar al usuario", "FCM".
deploy: CI/CD with GitHub Actions generated from the project's stacks - CI per stack, web deploys to Firebase Hosting, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages or Netlify with PR previews, backend deploys, mobile releases to Play internal testing and TestFlight on tags; environments, secrets check, release signing. Use for "CI", "despliegue", "deploy", "pipeline", "subir a TestFlight".
auth: Authentication on Firebase or Supabase from one config (.dualcraft/auth/auth.json) - email, Google, Apple, phone, passkeys, guest and linking, 2FA, roles and route rules, account deletion; typed AuthService and sign-in/account screens per stack, server functions. Use for "login", "registro", "roles", "borrar cuenta", "passkeys", "2FA".
e2e: End-to-end tests from one spec (.dualcraft/e2e/flows.json) - Playwright for the web and Maestro for the apps, with flows derived from auth, routes, payments and store screenshots, run in CI for the web. Use for "tests e2e", "end to end", "Playwright", "Maestro", "prueba el login entero", "test de humo".
perf: Performance budgets (.dualcraft/perf/budgets.json) checked in CI - web Core Web Vitals with Lighthouse and bundle size per route, app size of the store builds, cold start measured locally with history. Use for "rendimiento", "la web va lenta", "Lighthouse", "tamaño del bundle", "la app pesa mucho", "arranque", "presupuestos de rendimiento".
video: Marketing videos with Remotion from one spec (.dualcraft/marketing/videos.json) - App Store app previews, Google Play promo, Reels/TikTok 9:16 and feed formats, per language, styled with the DS tokens, using the store screenshots, listing and release notes; rendered locally. Use for "vídeo", "Remotion", "vídeo promocional", "app preview", "reel de la nueva versión".
legal: Legal and privacy for EU/Spain apps and webs - data map (what data, why, legal basis, retention, providers) inferred from SDKs and schema; drafts of privacy policy, terms and cookie policy, App Store privacy and Google Data safety answers, iOS privacy manifest; checks account deletion, ATT, permission texts, cookie consent. Use for "privacidad", "RGPD", "política de privacidad", "cookies", "data safety".
design-system: Creates the project's claude.ai Design System (brand interview or from code), links it and pulls its tokens. Use for "crea el design system", "define la marca, colores o tipografía".
tokens: Pulls Design System tokens, checks WCAG contrast and generates theme code for every stack. Use for "actualiza los colores", "sincroniza el diseño", or when generated tokens are missing or stale.
design-screen: Designs a screen in the claude.ai Design canvas as mobile and web artboards with its states, using the design system. Use for "diseña la pantalla de…", "haz un mockup", "cómo se vería…".
design-to-code: Implements a designed screen with tokens only, existing components, accessibility and i18n, compared visually with the artboard. Use for "pasa este diseño a código", "implementa la pantalla de…", "maqueta esto".
security-global: Full security audit - threat model, scanner, rules vs schema, functions, payments, abuse, privacy - dated report and brain bugs. Use for "auditoría de seguridad", "¿es segura la app?", or before a public launch.
security-web: Web security review - auth, every endpoint and server action, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, headers and CSP, secrets. Use for "seguridad de la web", "¿es segura esta API?", or within a global audit.
security-mobile: Mobile security review (MASVS) - secure storage, network, deep links, manifest and ATS, release config, IAP verification, App Check. Use for "seguridad de la app", before a store release, or within a global audit.
release: Closes and ships a version - readiness checklist, version bump everywhere, CHANGELOG, tag, store notes per language, launch and follow-up. Use for "saca la versión", "cerramos la 1.3", "vamos a publicar", "release".
marketing: What to communicate in each update and ready copy - stores and ASO, web, social, in-app, push and email - with campaign plan, metrics and growth ideas. Use for "ideas de marketing", "cómo anunciamos esta versión", "ASO".
convert: Converts between stacks (web and mobile, or migrations) feature by feature - inventory, backend decisions asked to the user, neutral spec, native adaptation, verification. Use for "pasa la web a app", "haz la versión web", "migra a Flutter".
port: Deep code conversion between languages - Dart, Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript; Flutter, Compose (Android/KMP), SwiftUI, React Native - with side-by-side idioms, dependency mapping, a file plan and parity checks. Use for "pasa la app de Flutter a Kotlin", "convierte este código a Swift", "migra a KMP".
github: Syncs the brain with GitHub Issues - issues for tasks and bugs, milestones from versions, assignees, closing finished ones, importing new ones. Use for "sube las tareas a GitHub", "sincroniza con GitHub", "asigna esta tarea a…".
share: Publishes the roadmap or brain map as a private page for the team or, without internal details, for a client. Use for "comparte el roadmap", "enséñale el plan al cliente", "publica el mapa".
screenshots: Store screenshots - capture screens by deep link, frame them at Google Play and App Store sizes with captions per language. Use for "capturas para la tienda", "screenshots de la ficha", "imágenes de Play/App Store".
photos: Product photos from your real photos, free and local (.dualcraft/marketing/photos.json) - background removed on the CPU, white packshots for stores, transparent cutouts, brand backgrounds and ads with headline and call to action per language in the DS colours; no paid API. Use for "fotos de producto", "quita el fondo", "fondo blanco", "packshot", "anuncio con la foto del producto".
